messages:
alex: Heads up — payroll discrepancy for Claire Dupont on the Mar 31 payrun. Net is ~€400 lower than expected. Paystub shows French social charges applied twice. PAY IDs: `PAY-2026-03-31-42` (Payline) and `REM-2026-03-31-12` (Remote). Screenshot attached in thread. Can payroll ops take a look?

gina (People Ops): Thanks for flagging @alex. Was Claire converted or did she change residence mid-period? Please redact any SSN/SIRET.

alex: Converted from contractor -> employee mid-month (conversion effective 2026-03-15). Residence/country set to FR starting 2026-03-01. No PII here, but non-PII details from paystub: 

```
Gross salary: €5,500
Employee social (FR): €852.50
Employer social (FR): €852.50
Total deductions shown: €1,705
Net paid: €2,800
Expected net (single charge): ~€3,200
```

javier (Payroll): Looks like both providers charged social contributions — one as employee lines and the other as employer/employee lines. If both Payline and Remote were active for the same pay period the migration may have caused duplicate deductions. Can you confirm both providers processed March 31 for Claire?

alex: Yes, we accidentally left the Remote contractor profile active while spinning up Payline employee runs. So Claire ran in both systems for the partial month. I think Remote did contractor->employee mapping and also applied FR social because country flagged as FR.

javier (Payroll): Ok — that explains the double-charge. Plan: 1) create an off-cycle reversal for the duplicate run, 2) reissue corrected pay from the single canonical provider, 3) coordinate with accounting to reclaim any employer-side overpayments. I can start the reversal now but need approval to proceed with off-cycle.

gina (People Ops): Approved. Please prioritize — Claire has an urgent rent payment on April 5. @javier, if reversal + corrected pay won't clear in time, propose a bridging advance.

javier (Payroll): Starting reversal now. REV created: `REV-176777-01`. ETA for reversal posting: same day for Payline, Remote may take 24-48h depending on settlement. Corrected run targeted EOD.

remote-billing-bot: Off-cycle reversal created id REV-176777-01 for payrun REM-2026-03-31-12.

claire dupont: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick action. If it matters, my expected net (for budgeting) was ~€3,200, I can confirm rent due 2026-04-05.

javier (Payroll): @gina — Remote settlement might not arrive before the 5th. Recommend People Ops approve a short-term advance of €1,500 (recouped on the next payroll) so Claire isn't short on rent. This avoids grossing up and extra tax complexes.

gina (People Ops): Approved. Will process a bridging advance via manual payment today. Note to payroll: mark it as a recoverable payroll advance in the ledger.

payroll-bot: Manual advance transaction queued: ADV-176777-01 for €1,500 to employee CLD-092. Processing expected today.

javier (Payroll): After reversal and corrected run, we'll issue a journal to accounting to reclaim duplicate employer social contributions and update the vendor reconciliation. I'll follow up with the reclaim ticket and attach screenshots.

gina (People Ops): Thanks @javier. CLARIFICATION: please also update the employee record so Remote contractor profile is disabled and Payline is the single source of truth for Claire going forward. Add a short post-mortem note in the migration doc so this doesn't repeat.

alex: Will close the loop on disabling the Remote profile and update the migration checklist.

claire dupont: Appreciate everyone moving fast. Please DM me once the advance posts.

gina (People Ops): Will do. Summary / next steps: 1) @javier start off-cycle reversal (REV-176777-01) — in progress; 2) reissue corrected pay from Payline by EOD; 3) process €1,500 bridging advance today (ADV-176777-01); 4) accounting reclaim ticket for employer social duplicates; 5) disable Remote contractor profile and update migration doc. I'll follow up here when each milestone completes. :raised_hands:
